column2: User asked Estrilda/Belinda to automatically use four distinct source-informed skills, not rotate four sprite rows for one ability. Added hero-skills.js, integrated in index.html/config.js, distinct cooldown UI, buff/knockdown feedback, and brief documentation.

Fandom Estrilda/Belinda requests HTTP402; no page content retrieved. Secondary references https://afk.guide/estrilda/ and https://afk.guide/belinda/ retrieved. Source summaries retained in conversation; no assertion of exact current official version fidelity.

Joust:5x60% plus150% finishing hit with knockdown; Royal Charge:200% near travelled segment, knockdown, resists control during charge; Inspire:living allies+30% attack8s; Ridicule:150% primary plus60% nearby and14% outgoing damage reduction6s.

Divine Light:4 timed110% area hits; Divine Retribution:160% orb area explosion on arrival; Brilliance:passive12% crit probability with proc feedback; Blessing:highest-current-attack living ally+15% attack/+15% crit. Brilliance is not a fourth manually/automatically cast active skill.

All skills unlocked from start; base coefficients only, no official level unlock tiers/energy ultimate system/signature/furniture. Cooldowns/delays/ranges/geometry/crit multiplier/knockdown/Blessing duration are explicit prototype tuning. Sprite-row mapping inferred, not author metadata. Different buff IDs add, same buff refreshes rather than stacks.

Independent cooldowns select oldest executable skill, otherwise approach oldest ready offence using its own range; channels schedule real timed hits; caster death/control cancels unreleased hits; Royal Charge duration permits travel from cast range; released orb can land after source death. Pause uses simulation clock. Save format remains unchanged.

Read-only lead-programmer review identified charge travel shortfall, max-buff suppressing Blessing attack, and range-tuning stall. Four new regression cases FAILED before fixes and passed after. Corrected all3 issues. Original14 skill-mechanic cases also pass.
